description: This bar chart illustrates the module Giga FLOPS for different attention mechanisms and feed-forward layers across three stages of an audio back-end Conformer. The horizontal axis represents the “Audio back-end Conformer Stage”, with categories labeled “Stage 1 (d=180, n=500)”, “Stage 2 (d=256, n=250)”, and “Stage 3 (d=360, n=125)”, arranged in sequential order. The vertical axis is labeled “Module Giga FLOPS” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. For each stage, there are four bars representing different module types: “attention” (blue), “grouped attention (g=3)” (orange), “patch attention (k=3)” (green), and “feed-forward” (yellow). In Stage 1, the “attention” bar reaches approximately 0.24, while the “feed-forward” bar reaches approximately 0.11. In Stage 2, the “attention” bar reaches approximately 0.18, and the “feed-forward” bar reaches approximately 0.13. In Stage 3, the “attention” bar reaches approximately 0.14, and the “feed-forward” bar reaches approximately 0.17. Within each stage, the bars are grouped by module type, and no bars are visually emphasized.
